question: Identify spatially variable genes (FDR < 0.05) in the provided spatial gene expression data using Moran's I spatial autocorrelation.

expected_output.guidelines: Gene records and their Moran's I (I_stat), p-value (pval_norm), and FDR (pval_norm_fdr_bh) values must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; output must include a gene name column (gene_name); column order and row order may differ.
